name: firecrawl
description: Firecrawl web data for Codex: search, scrape, crawl, map, interact, and agent jobs via the Firecrawl CLI, plus optional MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Search, scrape, and crawl the web with Firecrawl
interface.longDescription: Bundle of Firecrawl CLI workflow skills for live web research and extraction in Codex. Optionally loads the Firecrawl MCP server for structured tools (search, scrape, crawl, map, extract). Requires a Firecrawl API key from firecrawl.dev.
defaultPrompt: Use Firecrawl to search the web for the latest release notes on Next.js App Router and summarize.
Use Firecrawl to scrape https://docs.firecrawl.dev and list the top-level doc sections.
